_about: Askers that do not use the one function (src/lib/case-system/caseFile/factStatus.ts) yet, each with its reason and the slice that moves it. test:askers-fact-status: may only shrink, stale entries fail, empty at slice 6 (site owner, 11 Nov 2026).

entries.reason: Asks nothing itself: matched only by a code comment ("needs confirming"). Its continue rule is continueNeeds (intakeReview.ts, on the one function). Proposed guard rule (needs the site owner's yes): markers count in code, not comments.

Supplies the analysis's AI-written questions; it shows nothing. The one screen that shows them (IntelligenceOverviewPanel.tsx) filters each through mayAskWords. Proposed guard rule (needs the site owner's yes): a producer is on the one function when every screen showing its questions filters them through it (asserted by the guard).

Supplies the analysis's AI-written questions and missing-information lines; it shows nothing. IntelligenceOverviewPanel.tsx filters the questions through mayAskWords. Same proposed producer rule as civilAnalysis.ts.

Picks its next question through statusTriage.ts selectNextTriageQuestion(record, deferred, file), which asks the one function (mayShowQuestion) for each question since 17 Nov (Chrome milestone pass 2, finding 7); listed because the page itself imports nothing from factStatus.ts. Proposed guard rule: a screen whose questions come only from an asker on the one function is on it.

Wording only (string constants, no logic): "Not answered yet: add it when you know" and the like; every caller decides when to show it, through the one function. Proposed guard rule (needs the site owner's yes): a file of string constants only is not an asker.

Every question goes through chatQuestionToAsk (caseFile.ts), which calls chatMayAsk, the one function's chat gate; its own repeat filters only remove more. Listed because it imports the wrapper, not factStatus.ts. Proposed guard rule (needs the site owner's yes): a wrapper asserted to call the one function counts.

Depth questions: every authored question for a claim's elements is asked, by the site owner's Session 48 decision (word matching once marked elements as given that the person never gave). Moving it needs each element mapped to a case-file fact: a decision for the site owner, not made here.
Helper filters over AI-written questions (filing, stage, municipality words), run before the screen's own mayAskWords (IntelligenceOverviewPanel.tsx). Same proposed producer rule.

Server analysis (no case file in the request): writes "What to confirm next" lines from the intake input. The questions among them are shown only through IntelligenceOverviewPanel.tsx's mayAskWords; the contact lines are not shown as questions. Same proposed producer rule; or the analysis route could read the case (a database read, not added without the site owner's yes).

Server: the AI writes the law questions (no case file in the request). The one screen that shows them, SourcedQuestions.tsx, filters each through mayAskWords since 17 Nov. Same proposed producer rule.

Server: the home page's AI reading questions (only a summary of the start's answers in the request). The one screen that shows them, CaseUnderstandingCard.tsx, filters each through mayAskWords; Chrome milestone pass 2's finding 4 is fixed there (factsOfQuestion.ts patterns). Same proposed producer rule.
